correctness.rationale: A root-upward Abelian flux recurrence exactly counts every ordered preference sequence by subtree labeled-car interleavings. The certificate enumerates all 201 nonisomorphic tree types through ten vertices, all loads and all roots (16,755 exact root evaluations), and independently directly enumerates the ten-vertex witness preference sequences at loads four and five. For all positive a,b, the polynomial orbit classification uses each equality pattern exactly once with falling-factorial multiplicities and symbolically proves five root-gap identities; their strict signs give the infinite nonperipheral family. These are exact finite computations plus an algebraic proof, not finite experiments extrapolated to infinity.

value.rationale: Root placement is a natural optimization question in parking processes. The sharp first failure of selecting any diameter endpoint, the exact unique ten-vertex witness, its two load thresholds and the full infinite parameter family of explicit root-count gaps identify structural and load-sensitive behavior not supplied by merely restating the parking recurrence. The all-order a,b symbolic formulas are independently reusable for further optimal-root research.
